criteria.description: Structures the answer as the Playing-to-Win cascade — winning aspiration, where to play, how to win, capabilities, management systems — as linked CHOICES, not goals/initiatives.
Makes a specific where-to-play choice AND explicitly names where it will NOT play / who it gives up, rather than targeting everyone.
Gives a defensible, arena-specific reason it will win (and why it's hard to copy), not 'best features' or 'better UX' generically.
Shows the choices reinforce each other (capabilities serve the how-to-win; systems build the capabilities).
States what must be true for the strategy to work and/or the biggest risks to test.
